component.name: PintRust
component.summary: Browse Pinterest in a native window

description.p: A lightweight, native Pinterest client for GNOME. It embeds Pinterest in WebKitGTK with a compact libadwaita header bar, persistent login sessions, smooth video playback and automatic light/dark theme synchronisation with the desktop.

ul.li: Native GTK4 / libadwaita window with back, forward, home and reload controls
Persistent cookies and cache, so you stay signed in between restarts
Third-party links open in your default browser
Google, Facebook and Apple sign-in popups stay inside the app
Follows the system light or dark style immediately
